meta.dataset_name: Indravati River at Chindnar (Chhattisgarh, India) - CWC telemetry

scenario_definitions.missing_10: 10% of readings of every sensor set missing independently (MCAR)
scenario_definitions.missing_30: 30% of readings of every sensor set missing independently (MCAR)
scenario_definitions.noise_low: additive Gaussian noise on all sensors: level sd = 0.10*level_sd, rain sd = 0.10*rain scale
scenario_definitions.stuck: level and first rain sensor frozen at last value in random segments covering ~10% of steps
scenario_definitions.conflict: first rain sensor reads 0 during ~15% segments (clogged) and spurious rain at 1% of dry steps
scenario_definitions.spikes: 2% of level readings +/- U(4,8)*level_sd; 1% of each rain sensor + U(2,5)*rain scale

meta.positive_class: alert = High or Critical (observed level at the horizon >= train mean + 2 sd)

bootstrap.method: moving-block bootstrap of the clean test period

1.objective: validation alert F1 + 0.25 x 5-class macro F1

3.objective: validation alert F1 + 0.25 x 5-class macro F1
